title: W21 Mac references: the find bar (Ctrl+F / ⌘F)
about: BLOCKED on a Mac hook, not yet added (it needs a safety review): ⌘F can't be sent (cmd+t is the only key allowed) and the find bar has no clickable opener, so these states use the proposed KITE_TEST_FIND ("text": once the window's first page has finished loading, in test-safe mode only, showFind(nil) then FindBar.setQuery(value), which only searches the page) and KITE_TEST_FIND_OPEN ("flag": the same with no query). Until both are in HOOKS and the base has them, this request is refused and runs nothing. Session: windows/helix/states/find-bar.json from helix/W21-find (sidebar.json with pageAppearance light, so both apps' bars are light whatever the runner's appearance), the selected tab https://example.com/, which has two matches for "domain" (its heading and first sentence). The Windows captures are Kite.exe --capture --window-size 1280,820 --capture-scale 2 --find "" | --find domain --find-result 1/2 | --find zqxj --find-result 0/0 on the same session.

states.name: find-empty
states.holds: the find bar open and empty over example.com, 10pt in from the content card's top-right corner: the magnifier, "Find in page…", the arrows, the divider and close; no counter

states.name: find-matches
states.holds: the find bar with "domain" typed and the counter reading 1/2, the first match highlighted on the page

states.name: find-none
states.holds: the find bar with "zqxj" typed and "Not Found" in red where the counter goes
